newsitem.title: USA: Metro Vision changes name to York Hannover.
newsitem.headline: Metro Vision changes name to York Hannover.

text.p: Metro Vision of North America Inc said it will change its name and symbol to York Hannover Health Care Inc.

The new York Hannover's chairman, Thomas Clarke, said the company will also change its strategy to focus on increasing the number of long term health care facilities to which it provides institutional pharmacy services.
Metro Vision merged with York Hannover Pharmaceuticals Inc on April 2.

The new York Hannover provides pharmacy services to residents of long term health care and assisted living facilities in the Tampa Bay, Florida region. The company will trade on the Bulletin Board under the symbol "YHHC."
